checks.note: Terraform providers use ~> ranges (aws ~> 6.14, github ~> 6.6) and there is no .terraform.lock.hcl; no package-lock.json exists in the tree although the Dockerfile and CI run npm ci against it, so npm transitive dependencies are not pinned by hash.
Both model IDs are dated snapshots, hardcoded with no env fallback; adapter is null.
Only provider-hosted API models are used; no self-hosted weights, adapters or datasets are loaded.
No pickle-capable loads (pickle, torch, joblib, .pkl) found anywhere in the repo.
Served model from the response is audited separately from the requested model; the classifier also records res.model and refuses on mismatch.

note: C05.1 fails because the npm lockfile and Terraform lock file are missing and Terraform providers use ~> ranges; the other checks hold.
